record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; the linked report and result files are not included in the provided text. Code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes a two-model replication-and-extension of the original refusal-direction work and reports held-out effects from interventions using independently selected directions.
record.gate_note: The README reports four aggregate held-out behavioral metrics for each model. It also states that shuffled-label directions could remain strongly aligned, reference-orthogonalization removed the Qwen shuffled effect, and the Kanana residual coincided with severe off-target KL; it does not give the corresponding numerical results or enough detail to make separate result rows. Filenames in the repository listing are not treated as reported results.
record.test_reason: Replicates the original difference-in-means direction with directional ablation and addition on two new 3B instruct models, using the original repo's data. It reports held-out bypass and induction rates, which bear directly on V1.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is broadly correct. Both models gave stable directions and sizeable held-out effects, but protocol choices changed the interpretation. The Kanana orthogonalized residual 'did not establish a second refusal mechanism'. The authors disclaim a universal refusal circuit.
record.recipe_differences: The README describes a replication-and-extension using independently selected directions in Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Kanana-2-3B-Instruct, without transferring directions or layer indices. The supplied text does not provide enough protocol detail to confirm exact equivalence to the original procedure.
record.method_sensitivity: Model family and protocol choices are reported to change interpretation: the transported Qwen-style sign filter retained only 13/128 harmful Kanana training prompts and 2/32 harmful validation prompts; raw shuffled-label directions could remain strongly aligned; reference-orthogonalization removed the Qwen shuffled effect, while the Kanana residual coincided with severe off-target KL.

fits_no_version.finding: Geometric similarity alone did not reliably rank the causal strength of candidate directions.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The cosine or geometric similarity of candidate refusal directions does not predict their causal intervention strength.

fits_no_version.finding: Raw shuffled-label directions could remain strongly aligned with the selected direction. This is a negative-control concern for difference-in-means estimation.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Difference-in-means refusal directions partly reflect label-independent activation structure.

record.peer_reviewed: GitHub; the README says the research artifact has not been peer reviewed.
record.problems: The supplied text is only the README and file list, not the linked full report or detailed result tables. The README says phrase matching is not an independent safety judge, the manual audit is small and single-rater, and a clean source test is not a substitute for a fresh full GPU rerun. It reports no uncertainty estimates and does not establish preservation of general capability.
record.rows_left_out: No numerical rows are available in the supplied text for shuffled-label alignment, reference-orthogonalized controls, off-target KL, direction stability, or geometry-behavior correlation; these are only summarized qualitatively or referenced via files in the repository listing.

untested.parts: Preservation of other abilities: no capability evaluation is reported for the main direction.
No multi-direction or cone test is reported. The orthogonalized residual is mentioned only qualitatively.

missing.what: Unintervened baseline refusal rates on harmful and harmless held-out prompts, needed to read r1–r8 as effects.
Shuffled-label control effects and the reference-orthogonalized control behavior and off-target KL, for both models.
Faithful-baseline results under the original protocol for Kanana: the sign filter kept 13/128 training and 2/32 validation prompts.

record.verdict_notes: Only the README was available. The report and result files are not included. Phrase-matching metrics, a small single-rater manual audit, and no uncertainty estimates are reported. The Kanana results appear to use an adapted protocol, so the model-family difference may be partly a protocol difference. The study does not show that other abilities are preserved.

versions.untested_parts: Whether other abilities are largely preserved is not established by the reported held-out bypass and induction metrics; the README notes severe off-target KL for the Kanana residual control but does not report a general capability evaluation.
No released-model weight edit or abliteration result is reported.
No jailbreak suppression or training-against-ablation robustness result is reported.
The README reports shuffled-label and orthogonalized-control observations, but does not test whether refusal is better described by an affine set, cone, or multiple directions.
No separate measurement of harmfulness judgment and refusal decision is reported.
Directions and layer indices were not transferred between models; no transfer test is reported.
No variation in refusal-training method or timing is reported.
